_comment: Curated presentation for each project. Name must match the GitHub repo name. Description, language, stars and links come live from the GitHub API. Repos not listed here still appear under 'More on GitHub'. frame: window (default), tv or menubar. A shot of "component:<name>" renders a live HTML mock-up from COMPONENTS in app.js.

One set of components takes on the look of Windows 11, Windows 10, macOS 26, macOS 13–15, GNOME, KDE and ChromeOS, and follows the accent colour, light/dark mode, contrast and text size the user chose in the OS, in the browser and in Wails, Tauri or Photino.NET.
